import pytest

from roman import to_roman, from_roman


class TestToRoman:
    """Tests for to_roman(n)."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("n,expected", [
        (1, 'I'),
        (4, 'IV'),
        (5, 'V'),
        (9, 'IX'),
        (10, 'X'),
        (40, 'XL'),
        (49, 'XLIX'),
        (50, 'L'),
        (90, 'XC'),
        (99, 'XCIX'),
        (100, 'C'),
        (400, 'CD'),
        (500, 'D'),
        (900, 'CM'),
        (1000, 'M'),
        (1999, 'MCMXCIX'),
        (2023, 'MMXXIII'),
        (3000, 'MMM'),
        (3999, 'MMMCMXCIX'),
    ])
    def test_known_values(self, n, expected):
        assert to_roman(n) == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("n", [-1, 0, 4000, 10000])
    def test_out_of_range(self, n):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(n)

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("n", [1.5, 3.14, -0.0, 0.0])
    def test_float_rejected(self, n):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(n)

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("n", ["1", "abc", None, True, False])
    def test_non_integer_rejected(self, n):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(n)

    def test_round_trip(self):
        for i in range(1, 4000):
            assert from_roman(to_roman(i)) == i


class TestFromRoman:
    """Tests for from_roman(s)."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("s,expected", [
        ('I', 1),
        ('IV', 4),
        ('V', 5),
        ('IX', 9),
        ('X', 10),
        ('XL', 40),
        ('XLIX', 49),
        ('L', 50),
        ('XC', 90),
        ('XCIX', 99),
        ('C', 100),
        ('CD', 400),
        ('D', 500),
        ('CM', 900),
        ('M', 1000),
        ('MCMXCIX', 1999),
        ('MMXXIII', 2023),
        ('MMM', 3000),
        ('MMMCMXCIX', 3999),
    ])
    def test_known_values(self, s, expected):
        assert from_roman(s) == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("s", [
        'IIII',   # repeated non-singleton
        'VV',     # repeated V
        'IC',     # invalid subtractive
        'XM',     # invalid subtractive
        'MMMM',   # too many Ms
        '',       # empty string
        'banana', # non-roman chars
        'ABC',    # all non-roman chars
        'HIJ',    # mix of valid and invalid
        'A',      # single invalid char
        '0',      # digit
        ' ',      # whitespace
        '-I',     # negative sign prefix
    ])
    def test_invalid_numerals(self, s):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman(s)

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("s", [None, 42, 3.14, b'MCM'])
    def test_non_string_rejected(self, s):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman(s)

    def test_round_trip(self):
        for i in range(1, 4000):
            assert to_roman(from_roman(to_roman(i))) == to_roman(i)
